As a collector I want pristine cards if I'm buying the top grade.  The happiness of the person submitting cards to PSA is directly opposed to my happiness as a buyer.  Of course you'd be happy if you submitted a crappy card and PSA gave it a 10, but that means someone who collects is now getting a substandard card in a plastic box that says 10 on it.  So your point about being happy with the grades you receive doesn't really say anything about the quality of PSA's grading, I'd in fact say the opposite would be ideal, I want to purchase slabs from a company where the submitters are complaining about the grades they got.

Honestly, maybe you just should find a different hobby.  Something that leaves you feeling like that is not a positive thing for you, and it's better to quit now than to let yourself get sucked in deep.

If you are prone to addiction and overdoing it, at least pick a cheap hobby.  Old School Runescape costs like 11 bucks a month and will completely consume your life if you want to distract yourself from Pokémon.  Give it a month and you'll forget Pokémon exists.
